9fd84b16.task:
BLACK-BOX RECONNAISSANCE ONLY of in-scope target https://testphp.vulnweb.com (host: testphp.vulnweb.com). Do NOT run exploit payloads, injection tests, or vulnerability scanners. Map the attack surface thoroughly and write shared notes.

AUTHORIZATION: Platform-verified in-scope. Only this host. Do not test any other domain.

CALL get_threat_model(target="https://testphp.vulnweb.com") first. It will be empty; do NOT invent a full threat model yourself — the parent will save it from your recon. You MAY create_note entries.

OBJECTIVES (quick-scan, bounded, high-signal):
1. Confirm host/port/scheme reachability (HTTPS 443; also check HTTP 80 redirect). Light nmap of common web ports only — do not scan huge port ranges.
2. Fingerprint: server, PHP version if leaked, cookies, security headers, WAF, TLS, tech stack.
3. Crawl the site (katana and/or agent-browser --session recon-mapper). Bound depth/duration. Extract:
   - All unique paths/pages
   - All forms (action, method, fields)
   - All query/body parameters
   - Auth/session flows (login, signup, cookies, CSRF tokens)
   - Links to AJAX, shop, guestbook, comments, search, artists, products, userinfo, file upload, hpp, flash, htaccess, etc.
4. Directory/file discovery: light ffuf/dirsearch of common PHP/app paths if katana misses them. Keep it bounded.
5. JS files: list and note interesting endpoints/params (do not deep-analyze XSS yet).
6. Identify roles: unauthenticated vs logged-in surfaces. If default/demo credentials exist on the page, record them in a note — do not brute force.
7. Parameter inventory: every attacker-controlled input (GET/POST/cookie/header) with the page that uses it.

DELIVERABLES:
- create_note titled "Attack surface inventory" (category=wiki, tags=["recon","inventory"]) with: hosts, tech, cookies, every endpoint+method+params+auth requirement, every form, interesting headers, observed roles.
- create_note titled "Auth and session model" (category=wiki, tags=["recon","auth"]) with login/signup/logout, cookie flags, CSRF presence/absence.
- record_coverage for: host fingerprinting, crawl completeness, auth mapping. Use outcome needs_follow_up only if something is incomplete; otherwise no_issue_found for recon-only surfaces (recon is mapping, not vuln testing).
- agent_finish with a structured summary of the inventory and recommended hunter targets (SQLi params, XSS reflections, IDOR object IDs, upload, LFI, CSRF state-changes). List open_items if any.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Quick mode: skip exhaustive subdomain brute force and huge dir wordlists. This is a single known host.
- Do not spawn children unless you truly need a parallel crawler.
- Write artifacts under /workspace/recon/ if you dump URL lists; keep them small.
- NEVER send SQLi/XSS/etc payloads. Benign requests only.
